The previously recorded gray-tiled corridor and left-side bathroom can be retained as historical progress; in this segment the view continued toward the bright doorway, the brown wooden structure on the right gradually came closer, and at F15 the camera is near the doorway with a corner of an adjacent space visible. It is not yet confirmed that the doorway has been crossed into the open living area, nor that the instructed right turn, sofa/TV on the left, dining table/chairs on the right, or the wall with two framed pictures have been reached.
